dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular light-grey 'O' shaped structures with distinct high-contrast perimeters. The gradient transitions from a dark charcoal exterior to a lighter grey interior ring, most defined in the central dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid light-intensity clusters; primary high-contrast features are predominantly annular with internal gradients rather than solid cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the most prominent macro-annuli form a complex polygonal spatial relationship across the mid-dorsal and lateral surfaces, with a primary triangular cluster on the upper flank.
